reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I have no positives...
It's just a money machine...
My dog ​​had a tumor in his spleen... and after detecting it with an ultrasound, I was told that the dog could undergo surgery to remove his spleen and analyze it with a biopsy... price around €1,600...
But first he had to have a CT scan... €780 (which we did)!!!!
When you're desperate, you do anything...
They should have said that a 12-year-old dog with a tumor in his spleen has very little chance of survival... take him home and enjoy what's left of him...
How did it end??
The day after the CT scan, my beloved dog died...
Zero professionalism and above all zero sincerity....
Never again!!!!!!!!!!!!
Not to mention the incredibly long waits on the phone to speak to the clinic...
After a few minutes, the line would drop and you'd have to start the wait again... a nightmare!!
VERY BAD EXPERIENCE!!!!!!!!!!
Our puppies are safe

I go to them for my two dogs.
I leave from Latina every time, and I don't regret it.

Dr. Destrero is truly excellent. His neurologists are excellent. Dr. Pitzorno is extremely competent and truly cares about the animal's well-being. Unlike other clinics that charge €100 for a quote, the prices are perhaps average, but much lower than other more famous clinics, which charge outrageous prices.

Simba, our Golden Retriever puppy, was cared for with impeccable professionalism and care. From the very first moment, we found expertise, helpfulness, and great attention, both towards Simba and ourselves!
I brought my kitten for an asthma problem, the vet who took care of it was kind, he immediately identified the problem and administered the appropriate therapy.
Fantastic staff, especially the young Destrero, made everything very reassuring! Highly recommended.
My Myocastor coypus puppy was treated very well
Well-prepared and courteous doctor
Very kind and knowledgeable!
Professional, honest, and helpful. I have a phobic dog, and the doctor managed to have minimal interaction with the dog, who doesn't tolerate being touched by strangers.

After four surgeries for herniated discs
(September 24, January 25, March, and July 26, photos in chronological order 🥹), we can jokingly say we've become Gold clients of the clinic! 😄

Jokes aside, we couldn't have asked for a better team. Professionalism, expertise, availability (even via cell phone during my moments of despair), and a great sense of humanity accompanied us every step of the way.

We hope to "lose our Gold status" and only return for a few checkups... 🤞🏻

A special thanks to Dr. Destrero and Dr. Carrozza.
First visit, and excellent impression. Expertise and passion.

I rarely write posts, but this is truly the case: this clinic has been treating my dachshund Giorgio for years. On this occasion, the situation was very delicate and was handled and resolved admirably. Dr. Di Natale—the specific reference—in addition to his usual professional expertise, demonstrated great patience, understanding, and courtesy... as well as being friendly (which doesn't hurt). Praise also goes to the secretaries, who, despite their grueling schedules, were also always courteous and smiling. In short, truly excellent. For Di Natale, it's fitting to say: "Dr. Di Natale...is truly a great vet!"

Alessio (Giorgio's dad)
I think there is no better place for Rome.
The clinic is small but well-organized. Unfortunately, parking is difficult.

Thanks to Dr. Corazza, who supported us medically and emotionally.
When professionalism meets emotional support, for us, the "parents" of our furry children, it means so much...just thank you.
We had cervical hernia surgery on our dachshund today. The staff was excellent, prompt, professional, and compassionate. My Dachshund is doing well now. Thank you all, dear Doctors!!❤️

I've been going to this clinic since it opened. It's excellent: excellent doctors, excellent services, excellent cleanliness, excellent courtesy, excellent organization. What's a bummer is the phone: I've been waiting for over half an hour and I'm first in line, but I've only wasted my time, because the clinic closes in 10 minutes. Let's hope we can book an appointment tomorrow!
Good evening!
The clinic is one of Rome's leading centers for neurosurgery and veterinary neurology, along with the one on Via Salaria.
For heaven's sake, don't take your pet to these incompetent people. Misdiagnosis, misinterpreted tests, and a lack of professionalism have caused permanent damage. They should change their careers.
Super clean clinic, friendly staff. One of the best veterinary orthopedists in Italy, Dr. Angelici, visits this clinic.

After about 30 minutes of waiting on the phone between the first call and the second, the disk tells me that all users are currently unavailable and to call back later, what do I have to do to speak to you?

Well done, well done
The smuggler problem has been solved
Not only were they good, but they also had a fair price.
I went to this clinic from 2009 to 2015, until my previous dog passed away, and then I returned today. I've always found professionalism, competence, and empathy.
Welcoming and scrupulous

I went to the Destrero Carrozza Clinic for my puppy's neurological problem! I had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Carrozza, who performed an MRI on my dog ​​and prescribed treatment after the response. My puppy is doing well now! The staff was very helpful and kind. I extend my heartfelt compliments to Dr. Carrozza. He is a truly SPECIAL doctor. I highly recommend him. He is available and very knowledgeable, and he explained everything to us with great patience. What can I say? I HIGHLY recommend him.
He helped me walk two dogs in really worrying conditions, with expelled hernias. Well done Dr. Destrero and Dr. Carrozza 🙏🏼 …
Clean clinic with friendly and empathetic doctors with special thanks to Dr. Enrico Chinca.
Fabio is top notch, excellent solutions for everything, good and competent

I waited on hold for 18 minutes with three people in front of me. When it was my turn, the automated voice said that due to the high traffic, all the operators were busy and to try again later, and then hung up. This happened twice.

A clinical legend. Giulio is the best vet in the world ♥️
Daniele Pepi
Congratulations to everyone, especially Dr. Pitzorno.

We just picked up our dog after spinal surgery. The staff were professional, efficient, and above all calm, which helps both animals and, more importantly, us owners, stay calm during these difficult times. Even though our dog is very fearful and suspicious, the vets, especially Dr. Pitzorno, were exceptional, with a caring attitude that in itself is an act of care. Thank you.
Good and competent
Dr. Di Natale and his entire professional staff are excellent. Highly recommended.
Very good veterinarians

Competence, professionalism, and empathy to match.
Recommended.
After many bad experiences, finally a professional and competent structure!!!
I must thank Dr. Di Natale for seeing us on Friday at 5:00 PM for Frodo's acute colitis. Dr. Fabio is competent, empathetic, and problem-solver.
Dr. Destrero seemed very, very good to me. The clinic is beautiful, clean, and functional.
Serious, honest and helpful people, above all honest
I finally found a special hospital for pets with all the specialists. Dott. Pizzorro helped me address the health issue of my cat, Ivy.

More than a clinic, I'd say it's an assembly plant. We had the misfortune of having to deal with this clinic for an emergency. Our trusted veterinarian had referred us to them for an emergency specialist consultation and a brain MRI. So far, everything was normal. After speaking to at least five different vets, the diagnosis was a cerebral hemorrhage. The diagnosis was followed by a prescription for cortisone and antibiotics (in tablet form, but the dog was unable to swallow and was experiencing intermittent vomiting). We were never told that the dog's life was in danger. Specifically, Dr. Carrozza encouraged us to indulge the dog if he wanted to go for a walk or do any other activity, stating that he would recover within two or three days.
When he entered the clinic, the dog presented with left hemiparesis. Upon leaving, without any pharmacological treatment, he was returned to us in the same condition. In fact, the staff urged us to put him down and let him walk, but specifically, the dog wouldn't stand up. We spoke to at least six people, but no connection was established between the doctor and the patient's owner; the dog was treated like a number. Either they didn't realize the severity of the situation, or they didn't want to tell us, and they didn't even tell the veterinarian who sent us to them. The dog died 48 hours after the consultation after receiving the injection, as the condition had steadily worsened, leading to a coma. It was probably, indeed certainly, impossible to save our little one, but a doctor should never underestimate the condition and its associated risks. In fact, we were reassured, and none of the various veterinarians ever mentioned the risk of death. The next day, after a difficult night, we went back to our trusted veterinarian to discuss alternative therapy to pills and the actual life expectancy. Unfortunately, a few hours later, the dog, following another stroke, fell into a coma with clear signs of other neurological problems. After a harrowing night, we released him from his suffering. The total cost of this major diagnosis and treatment was €920, and the 360 ​​km round trip to get to the luminaries to have them tell me something that we, the owners, had also understood.
Excellent welcome, trained professionals, average price.

Extremely expensive, professional, and not particularly empathetic, but rightly so, like me, they prefer animals to humans; Dr. Ilaria, the epitome of sweetness.
Neurosurgery for a cervical hernia in my French bulldog, tests, MRI, anti-inflammatory pills, and a follow-up visit after 10 days, €3,062.
I highly recommend the Destrero Carrozza Clinic for any diagnosis requiring further investigation. The staff is friendly and welcoming, and the doctors are highly trained and courteous.

As a colleague, I'd like to express my deepest gratitude and appreciation to Dr. Destrero, Dr. Carrozza, Dr. Marinelli, and the entire team at the facility for immediately making themselves available to operate on my 10-year-old dog for a serious cervical hernia. They were all incredibly kind and professional, the surgery went very well, and my little Biro is back to being the happy dog ​​he always was, thanks to them! I recommend this facility to everyone, filled with talented professionals who work with love and dedication and a great team spirit. Thank you all so much!
Very good

What can I say? I had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Destrerio. My furry friend started walking again. I found him to be very good and always available during the months of therapy. Thank you very much, Doctor. A hug from Naples.
I had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Di Natale and I had a great impression...very empathetic and competent. Well done!

I brought my dog ​​to this clinic for an emergency an hour before closing time, and the staff was incredibly kind and knowledgeable in handling the situation, treating my dog ​​with patience and kindness. Highly recommended, with reasonable prices: I will consider it again in the future!

I came across this clinic too late, but from the short time I spent there, I can assure you it was one of the best experiences I've had in my dog's 19 years of life. From the girls in the waiting room, always very kind and patient, to the interactions with the doctors, especially in my experience with Drs. Longo, Verolino, and Destrero, who cared for my little one's final weeks and helped us say goodbye to him with great empathy, compassion, and rationality during the most critical moments.

Truly an exceptional clinic that I will never stop recommending to anyone in need. Thank you so much for helping me say goodbye to my little dog with all the humanity possible. ❤️
This is the first time I've had such a thorough and attentive visit. The vet was very empathetic with my dog.
I had a great time with Professor Carrozza, he's a really good person.
They've been treating my dog ​​for 10 years, always exceptional, helpful, and professional. Highly recommended.
Very kind, attentive, scrupulous.
The vets were very good and all the staff were very kind.
Professionals

Good morning, I've been going to Destrero for decades and have always had an excellent experience. The clinic has highly trained staff, a very friendly receptionist, and is always very clean. I recommend it!
Thanks to Dr. Di Natale. He was kind and reassuring during my cat Delia's dermatological visit. Very friendly staff.

This is my first visit to Destrero, and I simply want to say: Thank you so much! Especially to Dr. Fabio Di Natale, for helping us with our dachshund, Choco, who had been battling a foxtail a few months ago and its complications, which had already been treated at another clinic with considerable difficulty.

The doctor welcomed us warmly and immediately took an in-depth look at the new situation: through a simple needle aspiration, he identified the problem, correctly hypothesizing the presence of a foxtail fragment, which was later confirmed by ultrasound the same day. At another facility, the same morning, I had been told that the swelling and inflammation could be caused by an insect bite and to "wait and see"!

I thank him not only for his thoroughness, but also for providing me with clear guidance and concrete solutions, allowing me to resolve Choco's problem safely and before mid-August, avoiding pain and unnecessary waiting. Thanks also for contacting me by phone, providing further guidance in the following days.
Professionalism, patience, attention, and true care: these are the qualities we found.

Unfortunately, my experience ended sadly with the death of one of my cats (Puma). The vets are empathetic, down-to-earth, and before performing expensive tests or investigations, they evaluate whether it's worthwhile. Costs are generally reasonable: an MRI scan is expensive, but it's an expensive procedure; a specialist visit costs the same as a "normal" visit. I also found the reception staff welcoming. I highly recommend it. It's a clinic specializing in neurology.

Sweet Wendy...you are not just a "dog" you are our sweet little dog...you are a little daughter...a little sister...a little niece...a friend...you almost forcefully entered our lives in a dramatic moment of pain...and you gave us so much, indeed so much...you got sick...and we are helping you heal...certain and confident of a full recovery.
I would like to heartily thank the Ambulatorio Veterinario Destrero Carrozza clinic for their great humanity and empathy, but above all for the peace of mind they were able to give us.
I also want to thank Ambulatorio Veterinario Case Basse, especially Dr. Stefania Gallone for the timely diagnosis.
I would like to say a special word to my husband Marco Talone, thank you for the strength and love you give me every day...I love you, my life.
Giulia Moretti and Vanessa Listorto, always ready with their sweetness.
And to my mom for being my pillar.
Thanks to everyone
❤️

Excellent veterinary clinic in Rome! I recently took my French bulldog there and was impressed by the professionalism of the entire team. The welcome was warm, the vet took the time to explain everything, and the care was impeccable. You can feel their genuine passion for animals, and everything is clean and well-organized. Even though I was just passing through, I felt completely confident. I highly recommend them.

Good morning, I've recently been attending this clinic, which was recommended to me by an acquaintance. I've never found such kindness, professionalism, and empathy anywhere else. It's a five-star treatment that we humans would like to find in our hospitals. Careful visits are carried out, and everyone is in control of the situation, so even if you end up with different doctors, everyone knows everything about your pet. I have two cats under my care, and one is undergoing special treatments, advice, care, and much more. The costs involved are high in some situations, but they offer solutions that are close to people's needs. I'm very happy, thank you.
Excellent veterinary neurological clinic. Truly excellent work, it costs money, but it's worth it. The only downside is the wait to speak on the phone, but for your pet's health, it's top notch.
Professionalism and courtesy

Courtesy, professionalism, affordable prices!
I needed an urgent ultrasound for my Labrador who has a growth on his neck. The diagnosis was suspected to be lymphoma.
My vet, Dr. Assin, referred me.
The appointment was scheduled within two days. The ultrasound and fine-needle aspiration revealed, thankfully, a lipoma.
An abdominal ultrasound was also performed.
The report was issued immediately and also sent to my doctor!
One of the best clinics with the best professionals
WE LOVE DOCTOR ILARIA PITZORNO: WITH HER SIMPLICITY, SHE GOES BEYOND... SHE INSIGHTS, UNDERSTANDS, AND HELPS FURRY AND HUMANS. GENEROUS, INTELLIGENT, EMPATHIC... FOR US, SHE IS A POINT OF REFERENCE
The best!

After some bad experiences, a friend recommended Dr. Di Natale to us. My Argo suffered several abuses and spent four months at the vet getting him back on his feet before we adopted him, and examining him or administering treatments is no easy feat.

Di Natale is empathetic and knows the canine world inside out.

After the first visit, I decided he'll be Argo's vet.

I recommend him to everyone.

My vet recommended a neurological visit because my dachshund had a spinal injury.
What can I say...very kind and professional staff, from the reception to Dr. Ilaria Pitzardo. Thank you, it's one of the few veterinary clinics that don't just think about making money. Thanks again.
I forgot to mention something...
You're too far from where I live.
They saved my puppy. I can't thank them enough. A special thanks to Fabio.

The competence, professionalism, kindness and above all the humanity that I found in this clinic, from all the staff, including the secretaries, is truly rare, and anything but obvious, especially in the sector. I regret having met them late, when my dog ​​was already 14 years old, because he would have enjoyed all this for longer. I recommend them to everyone, and they will still be a point of reference for me. Achille also thanks you for all your affection ❤️

What can I say?! I'll start with Dr. Destrero, a clear, direct, and "concrete" doctor who works effectively on behalf of our furry friends. Then I'll move on to Dr. Carrozza, who surprised me with his expertise, simplicity, humanity, and even kindness! And then the girls at the front office (with big hearts!), like Martina and the gorgeous woman with blue eyes! I've only found people who truly "take care" of our furry companions with commitment, service, and true dedication. Kudos also to the two truly skilled and well-prepared anesthetists. Here, we don't profit off our pets! Here, we provide genuine and concrete care, without too much fuss.

Professional
A very kind and helpful doctor, attentive and meticulous.
Now all I can do is hope the dog gets better.
A wonderful, highly recommended place. We used it during our stay in Rome! Fantastic service for demanding customers.
For a year and a half, it's been my go-to clinic. Everyone is very good and competent. Highly recommended.
Top clinic
exceptional staff
They are kind, helpful and professional
Score 0 and I won't add anything else.
VERY BAD!

I had my dog ​​examined with great professionalism and expertise because of a sudden paralysis of his hind limbs. He underwent MRI scans and subsequent surgery in a single session, which resulted in my dachshund's full functional recovery. Thank you so much! Aldo Gioffre

The staff is highly trained, professional, and competent, but above all, empathetic and helpful.
Affordable and fair prices.
The range of services is extensive and multidisciplinary.

Terrible experience. We called several times about a serious spinal problem our dog had. We asked for information on how to transport him to the clinic.
Each time, they promised to have the neurologist call me back, but in two days, no call.
A truly terrible experience.
Very professional, very experienced. Excellent ultrasound, neurological exam, and orthopedic exam!

After wandering around Rome for a long time looking for a veterinarian or a reputable clinic, I finally found them a few years ago. A little inconvenient to reach by car, but the professionals are diverse, friendly, and always available for any needs. Prices are reasonable. Many procedures are done simply over the phone, and invoicing and some tests are available by email.
Optimal!
I didn't find the professionalism and humanity that they praised, but greed and indifference.

I finally found the vet for us, we have two cats, 9 and 8 years old, Dr. Longo was very good, scrupulous, sensitive, professional and gives the right advice, the place is very clean, being many doctors they also help you with emergencies, highly recommended

Beautiful facility.
Excellent experience with Dr. R. Assin: highly professional and kind!!🤗 …
Ever more efficient and punctual

I brought my cat in for a neurological issue, which fortunately had no consequences. The doctor was extremely knowledgeable and sweet; she tried to reassure me and suggested every possible course of action. The entire staff was understanding, kind, and professional. Thank you.
Fabio friendly and wonderful as always

I already knew the Destrero Center from having an MRI performed on one of my dogs, and from ultrasounds and visits with Dr. Assim. Today, I had the opportunity to appreciate, in addition to the cleanliness and serenity that exudes, the spirit of collaboration that has developed between colleagues, aimed at the patient's overall well-being. I thank Dr. Elisabetta Verolino and Dr. Ilaria Pitzorno for having the patience to listen to my dog ​​Gea's problems, for working together to resolve them, and for guiding me on the right path, immediately making themselves available to follow her progress. Last but not least, I appreciate their empathy and kindness. The center also has a talented orthopedic surgeon, Dr. Angelici, whom I recommend having tested him on my dog. Thank you again.
